title: The nonvanishing locus of an element of an invertible module over an affine scheme is affine
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and N an invertible R-module, meaning an R-module that is finite projective of rank 1 (equivalently, locally free of rank 1 on a cover of Spec(R) by standard opens D(f)). Let Sym_R(N) have canonical map iota as in [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. For s in N, let A=Sym_R(N) and B=A/(iota(s)-1)A. Then the morphism Spec(B) to Spec(R) [def-weil-affine-spectrum] identifies Spec(B) with the open subset V={p in Spec(R) | s is not in pN}; equivalently, V is affine.
